expectations.text: Every P value in the relief map equals (E + 2*S) * L for its row
expectations.evidence: Checker: (E+2S)×L equals P in all 8 rows (12, 27, 18, 18, 27, 16, 18, 27)

expectations.text: Exactly 3 vectors are activated, or 4 only when the 3rd and 4th places have equal P and equal S

Every activated vector block has a status line, and every block with status ФАТАЛЬНАЯ БРЕШЬ has an applied law, the vulnerability essence, an evidence line with at least one verbatim quote from the user's description, cascade mechanics and a threat index I x T x D whose product is arithmetically correct

expectations.text: Every applied law in a vector block belongs to that vector's own arsenal (its law number starts with the vector's number, e.g. 3.1.x inside vector 3.1)
A НЕ АКТИВИРОВАНЫ line lists every non-activated vector together with its P
The Kill Matrix contains no advice or recommendations on how to fix the system
expectations.evidence: Checker found no advice wording; only process line about bringing the matrix next cycle

expectations.text: If the isolation line says emulation in a single context, the response warns that context leaks between vectors are possible; if it says subagents, the vectors were run as separate subagents
